index.about.title: About Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram
index.about.intro: Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram is a revered Vaishnav spiritual center in the sacred city of Ayodhya, dedicated to Shri Ram Bhakti, Seva, and the preservation of Sanatan Dharma. Rooted in the Bhaktamal tradition and Ramanandi lineage, the Ashram serves as a place of devotion, discipline, and divine learning.
index.about.feature1.title: Traditional Roots
index.about.feature1.desc: Rooted in the sacred Ramanandi Sampradaya, inspired by the Bhaktamal tradition of Shri Ram devotion
index.about.feature2.title: Spiritual Center
index.about.feature2.desc: A center for Bhakti, Satsang, and spiritual learning under divine guidance of Maharaj ji
index.about.feature3.title: Sacred Location
index.about.feature3.desc: Located just 500 meters from Shri Ram Mandir in the holy city of Ayodhya
index.guruji.heading: Meet Maharaj ji
index.guruji.name: Mahanth Swami Shri Avdheshkumar Das Ji Maharaj
index.guruji.desc: A revered spiritual leader of the Ramanandi tradition, guiding devotees through Shri Ram Katha, Bhakti, and selfless Seva. Under his divine guidance, Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram continues the legacy of Bhaktamal parampara through Katha, Satsang, and Seva.
